catalog.search.name: catalog.search
catalog.search.description: List Acme plans of a category. With customer_email, also returns that customer and their current plan id (customer is null when no account has that email). With address_id (home only), returns only the home plans available at that address.

coverage.check.name: coverage.check
coverage.check.description: Check whether Acme home internet reaches a street address. Give the street type in full, for example Road, not Rd. Returns found, address_id, address, fiber_mbps (0 = no fiber) and five_g.

port.check.name: port.check
port.check.description: Check whether a phone number held at another carrier can move to Acme. Returns number, eligible and, when not eligible, a reason.

order.create.name: order.create
order.create.description: Place an order. type 'upgrade' takes customer_id and plan_id only. type 'new' takes plan_id and customer {name, email}, plus address_id for a home plan or port_number for a mobile plan that keeps a number.

notify_sales.name: notify_sales
notify_sales.description: Hand a lead to a human sales advisor. reason is one of callback, no_coverage, tool_failure, order_failed. customer holds name, email and/or phone (a phone or an email is required). summary is one or two sentences.
